final: SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(*) AS qc_records, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()) AS ratio_to_average FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux
